definitions.STRUCTURED: Dedicated MCP operation backed by documented Cavalry APIs
definitions.GENERIC_ATTRIBUTE: Available through generic layer, attribute, generator, or graph tools
definitions.RAW_SCRIPT: Only available through the explicitly enabled raw-script escape hatch
definitions.UI_ACCESSIBILITY: Implemented through the optional OS accessibility driver
definitions.UI_VISION: Implemented through verified visual UI interaction
definitions.UNSUPPORTED: Known capability without a reliable automation route in this build

Coediting.OptimisticConflictDetection.notes: Native callbacks advance sceneRevision; batches with expectedRevision abort as EDIT_CONFLICT when human edits intervene.

EditableShape.PathAnimation.notes: Native path keyframe/resync routes fail fast as KNOWN_HOST_LIMITATION on 2.7.2; verified safe helpers build persistent frame-sampled Editable Shape sequences with topology validation.

Selection.Assets.notes: Asset Window objects are inspectable; the public API has no independent asset-selection setter.

Transform.Toggle2_5D.notes: Cavalry 2.7.2 documents has3dTransforms() but no public enable/disable operation.

Camera.PlanarCamera.notes: Direct cameraType mutation fails fast on 2.7.2; normal Planar Camera attributes and semantic cut/transition helpers are the verified route.

Camera.Guides.notes: Native Camera Guide operations are host-unstable and now fail fast. camera_sequence_create is the verified semantic replacement, but it does not claim native Guide parity.

ControlCentre.ListDescribe.notes: The public API exposes add/remove only; the tools return a specific unsupported error.

Beat.SyncUtilities.notes: Use beat_get_nth plus batch keyframe/layer operations; there is no distinct Cavalry sync API.

Preferences.EnumerateKnown.notes: The optional macOS driver enumerates the active Cavalry profile; keyed reads/writes remain structured API operations.

Viewport.SetTool.notes: Verified against the deterministic Tool menu with tool_get_active readback.

Viewport.QAProfiles.notes: Profiles take explicit version-appropriate preference settings and always return the prior values for restoration.

Color.WorkingAndViewportSpaces.notes: Available only when exposed by current composition/preferences definitions.

Render.StatusAndWait.notes: No documented Cavalry 2.7.2 active-render status query exists, so reliable wait cannot be implemented.

Render.FormatsAndCodecs.notes: Installed generators are discovered generically. render_mux_audio supplies and ffprobe-verifies audio for HEVC/ProRes video when Cavalry 2.7.2 exposes no codec audio attributes.

NativeDialogs.notes: Accessibility path submission was not deterministic under Cavalry's file filters. The tools return PLATFORM_LIMITATION and direct callers to verified scene_open, scene_save_as, and project_set routes.

UI.CommandSearch.notes: Verified against live Cavalry menu command enumeration and exact command execution.

UI.Shortcuts.notes: Verified against live menu shortcuts and explicit key dispatch; user overrides are read from the active profile.

UI.VisionFallback.notes: No verified vision interaction driver is currently implemented.

Presets.notes: The live presets path is discoverable and concrete preset menu commands can be executed, but the clean profile has no preset fixture and Cavalry exposes no stable generic mutation contract.

Tags.notes: Tag controls remain PLATFORM_LIMITATION: Cavalry 2.7.2 exposes neither scripting methods nor stable Accessibility identifiers for generic tag mutation.

WorkspacesAndWindows.notes: Workspace enumeration, window commands, and Focus Mode pass live. Persistent layout mutations remain explicitly interactive and were not run unattended.

ThirdParty.SceneNodes.notes: Dynamic type, attribute, generator, and connection inspection covers plugin scene nodes.

ThirdParty.CustomUI.notes: Custom plugin UI outside node attributes requires a future accessibility driver.

RawScript.EscapeHatch.notes: Disabled by default and requires CAVALRY_ALLOW_RAW_SCRIPT=true.
